name: Minimum Model Count Verification
description: Verifies whether the stored minimum model count is still accurate by querying the models API, a models endpoint documented on the provider's own pages, the models page, or a fetched candidate page.
systemPrompt: You are a verification assistant. Compare the stored model count against the actual model count and determine if the value is still accurate. Return JSON with 'answer', 'observation' (one short sentence), and optional 'confidence'.

init-state.name: Initialize State
init-state.description: Initializes the verification state from the current research data.

is-dynamic-catalog.name: Is Dynamic Catalog
is-dynamic-catalog.description: Checks whether the provider's model catalog is dynamic (user-managed, unknowable by any method).

has-model-api.name: Has Model API
has-model-api.description: Checks whether a model discovery API endpoint is available.

query-models.name: Query Models
query-models.description: Queries the models API endpoint to retrieve the current model list.

discover-models-endpoint.name: Query Documented Models Endpoint
discover-models-endpoint.description: Reads the provider's own documentation pages and asks the models URL they state, which is where a gateway's public catalog usually lives when the stored base URL does not serve it.

has-documented-count.name: Has Documented Model Count
has-documented-count.description: Checks whether the documented endpoint returned a model list. Most providers publish none, which is a normal answer rather than a failed step, so the tree routes here instead of treating it as an error.

fetch-documentation-page.name: Fetch Documentation Page
fetch-documentation-page.description: Fetches the provider's documentation page so the extraction action can count models listed on it. Used when the models endpoint probe found no count (auth-gated or undocumented) but the documentation page may list the available models.

compare-count.name: Compare Model Count
compare-count.description: Compares the stored model count against the actual count from the API.

is-accurate.name: Is Accurate
is-accurate.description: Checks whether the stored model count matches the actual count.

has-models-page.name: Has Models Page
has-models-page.description: Checks whether a models page URL is available for fetching.

fetch-models-page.name: Fetch Models Page
fetch-models-page.description: Fetches the models page content for analysis.

web-search.name: Web Search
web-search.description: Searches the web for information about available models.

has-search-results.name: Has Search Results
has-search-results.description: Checks whether the web search produced any candidate URLs.

fetch-next-candidate.name: Fetch Next Candidate
fetch-next-candidate.description: Fetches the next candidate URL from the queue for model count extraction.

extract-model-count.name: Extract Model Count
extract-model-count.description: Uses LLM (with regex fallback) to extract the model count from page content.

keep.name: Keep
keep.description: Terminal node indicating the current value is still accurate.

update.name: Update
update.description: Terminal node indicating the current value needs to be updated.

skip.name: Skip
skip.description: Terminal node indicating verification was skipped due to insufficient data.
